name: Mehtar

physical.wears: a bull mask in teal and gold, patterned red and teal cloth

notes: Descendant of Kavik, and so of Mehme, carrying the Mask Family line into the post-cataclysmic era. Not recorded as a relation because the schema has parents and children and this is neither -- the line runs many generations back, and naming Kavik a parent would assert something false. Wears the bull mask as inheritance rather than office: the masks outlasted the family that answered for them, which is the same joke Bekh is the other half of. Filler while the epoch is written out.
